name: FM - Intake Utility File from SharePoint

trigger.operation: When a file is created (properties only)

scopes.name: Try - receive and validate
actions: Create fm_ingestionrun with correlation ID and status CHECKING
Create fm_ingestionfile with SharePoint item ID, file name, size and received time
Get file metadata and content using the trigger identifier
Reject disallowed extension, oversize content, duplicate file hash or unknown active mapping
Parse the bounded file using the approved parser selected by mapping version
Validate required headers without coercing source values

scopes.name: Try - append Bronze
actions: For each parsed source row, calculate the deterministic source-record hash
Upsert/create fm_bronze_utilityreadingraw or fm_bronze_utilitytariffraw with raw strings and lineage
Record duplicate observations instead of creating duplicate Bronze rows
Reconcile parsed, inserted, duplicate and rejected counts
Mark the raw run COMMITTED only when reconciliation passes

scopes.name: Try - request promotion
actions: Call fm_RequestUtilityPromotion with ingestionRunId and mappingVersion
The Custom API validates the request and enqueues bounded background processing
Do not transform the whole batch synchronously inside the plug-in

scopes.name: Catch
actions: Keep the source file and immutable landed rows
Mark fm_ingestionrun FAILED or DEGRADED without advancing a checkpoint
Create an actionable fm_dataqualityissue with safe error detail and correlation ID
Send an email only when an approved alert rule is met

retries.transientConnectorErrors: exponential policy; exact count/duration requires operations approval
retries.businessValidation: no automatic retry until mapping/data is corrected

constraints: No production URLs, IDs, credentials or connection references
Maximum file/row limits require volume and licensing confirmation
